scope: Incremental business value of PO-risk Var(u) methods (CF / BCF / bootstrap) and five product applications

estimators.baseline: empirical Var(u) or CF V_naive (leaf-size biased)
estimators.what_it_adds: Debias leaf-size inflation in Var(tau) so quiet/benign LIVE does not look malignant; leaf-merge floor min n=30/50 keeps segment monitors stable.

incremental_value.claim: Stops leaf-bias masquerading as integrity break → avoid wrong-drug freeze/retrain on synonym / mild covariate boards.
incremental_value.evidence: Synth justify 5/5 + real 4/4 with CF-debiased; honesty bias_ratio flags when debias mattered.
incremental_value.dollar_proxy: Wrong freeze on a benign finance synonym cell alone leaves ~$3.4k/1k on the table (business PR: conformal was the right cheap drug).

incremental_value.claim: Relative V_debiased↑ confirms Mag×Var / Y-flip → spend freeze+aug dollars only when shape+outcome agree.
incremental_value.evidence: Estimator separation suite: cf_V_debiased / cf_Var_u_tree separate malignant vs benign (hit-rate 1.0).
incremental_value.dollar_proxy: Finance malignant cell: cost/1k $8404→$4067 (~$4.3k) when freeze+aug is correctly selected.

estimators.when_not_enough: Need posterior intervals / Bayesian stack → escalate to BCF; need a 30-second sanity check → bootstrap.

estimators.baseline: CF point/debiased Var(u) without posterior draws
estimators.what_it_adds: Full posterior draws of tau via R bcf (rpy2 + pihat) → Var(u) as posterior spread; audit-grade uncertainty for regulated pipelines.

incremental_value.claim: Credible bands on unit risk for auditors: not only 'V is high' but 'posterior mass on integrity break'.
incremental_value.evidence: bcf_Var_u separates malignant/benign (suite ratio ~29×); backend rpy2_bcf with pihat.
incremental_value.dollar_proxy: Pays for itself when a single avoided AI-Act / escalation dispute exceeds MCMC cost (minutes of CPU vs legal/ops review).

incremental_value.claim: Drop-in when the org already ships BART/BCF; no second uncertainty language for risk teams.
incremental_value.evidence: Same triage actuators; only Var(u) backend swaps.
incremental_value.dollar_proxy: Integration cost ↓ vs inventing a fourth estimator.

estimators.when_not_enough: Latency-critical LIVE default → stay on CF; tiny n without pihat quality → prefer CF + bootstrap sanity.

estimators.what_it_adds: Intuitive refit of PermuCATE tau → Winsorized Var(u); catches gross misspecification cheaply.

incremental_value.claim: A/B against CF before a freeze: if boot and CF disagree wildly, hold + investigate instead of auto-escalate.
incremental_value.evidence: boot_Var_u still separates (suite ratio ~15×) but is heavier-tailed — never the product default.
incremental_value.dollar_proxy: One blocked false escalation (GPU retrain / human on-call) typically dwarfs bootstrap CPU.

estimators.when_not_enough: Do not use as sole freeze sensor (fourth-moment noise).

1_dynamic_routing.what_po_risk_adds: Var(u) + Mag×Var + Y-flip as a *confidence / disease* proxy: quiet/benign → light/cache/conformal; malignant → escalate.

incremental_vs_always_heavy.narrative: Industrial HC3 LIVE (business PR): routed actuators saved $22430 vs static — 100% shape hit-rate, so detection was not the bottleneck; right-drug selection was.

incremental_vs_always_light.narrative: Always-light would keep paying ~$20×FN on malignant cells; finance malignant alone drops cost/1k $8404→$4067 when escalated to freeze+aug.

2_canary_rollback.what_po_risk_adds: Segment Severity=J+Y-flip + CF Var(u): rollback only sick segments; keep canary elsewhere (micro-loss iteration).

incremental_vs_global_rollback.assumptions: 100k req, $0.01 canary uplift/req, equal segment share; global rollback zeros uplift; segment rollback zeros only sick share.
incremental_vs_global_rollback.narrative: Demo panel keeps 3/5 segments on canary → retain ~$600 uplift that a global rollback would incinerate.

incremental_vs_global_metrics_only.narrative: medicine + sci show Y-flip / high J while general/finance/talk stay quiet — global accuracy can look fine while verticals bleed; segment gate is the incremental sensor.

baseline_anti_patterns: drop_all_high_PO (throws away hard benign / synonym gold)
3_data_flywheel.what_po_risk_adds: Y-flip gate kills integrity poison; Y-flip=0 + mild J kept as distribution-expanding gold.

incremental_vs_ingest_all.assumptions: $25 expected remediation per poison sample ingested
incremental_vs_ingest_all.narrative: Drop rate 55% on demo panel → ~$550 avoided remediation vs ingest-all.

incremental_vs_drop_all_high_po.assumptions: $8 robustness value per gold sample; crude high-PO filter throws away ~half of mild-J gold.
incremental_vs_drop_all_high_po.narrative: Mag×Var distinguishes hard-but-clean from poison → keep gold rate 45% instead of scrubbing benign hard cases.

4_compliance.what_po_risk_adds: Segment risk-event narratives: window × segment × Y-break × J × V_debiased → local freeze — AI-Act-readable, not opaque.

events.narrative: In 2026-W44, segment=medicine detected integrity break (Y-flip=0.32, J=0.90, V_debiased=0.08) → local freeze.
In 2026-W44, segment=sci detected integrity break (Y-flip=0.28, J=0.70, V_debiased=0.05) → local freeze.

incremental_vs_black_box.assumptions: $5k unexplained incident review vs $0.4k auditable local-freeze note
incremental_vs_black_box.narrative: 2 integrity-break events become auditable freezes → ~$9200 review-cost delta on the demo window.

4_compliance.product_distinction: Separates watermark-scrubbed / synonym cosmetic from true outcome integrity break — the compliance incremental story.

5_agent_cascade.what_po_risk_adds: Per-step Mag×Var / Var(u): abort + self-correct / human when a step's residual variance spikes — stop cascade amplification.

incremental_vs_run_to_end.assumptions: $0.15/step tool waste after poison; $40 task-failure risk if cascade reaches synthesize
incremental_vs_run_to_end.narrative: Demo aborts at step 3 → avoid ~$40 expected cascade loss vs run-to-end.

rollup.note: Do not sum industrial + sim into one ROI — different ledgers. Pitch industrial $22430 as measured LIVE save; sim stack ($10534) as transparent unit-econ for canary/flywheel/compliance/agent on the demo panel.
rollup.pitch_one_liner: PO-risk Var(u) is an allocation rule: CF-debiased honesty for LIVE, BCF when auditors need posteriors, bootstrap as sanity — and the five apps turn that sensor into routing dollars ($22430 industrial), micro-loss canaries, clean flywheels, auditable freezes, and aborted agent cascades.
